# force-push-recovers-publisher-ownership

When the remote branch has diverged due to external commits, the publisher will force-push its snapshot, overwriting remote changes so the publisher's snapshot becomes the remote branch content.

Guarantee that the publisher can re-establish authoritative branch contents on the remote even if remote was modified by others.
